lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Clock strikes twelve and the shadow wakes
Every silent step is the ground I take
Black boots hitting on the cobblestone
Walking through the mist in the danger zone
Silver moonlight running down my spine
The city at midnight is finally mine
They chase the prey but the prey is gone
I'm the storm rising till the break of dawn
[chorus]
Neon fangs flashing in the dark tonight
Spells on my lips like a burning light
Heartbeat pounding like a drum of war
Breaking down every single locked door
I rise I burn I take back the crown
I am the queen when the sun goes down
[verse]
They think I'm running but I'm setting traps
Turning the maps into wreckage and scraps
Ghost in the wires and smoke in the air
Look at the throne that I built with a stare
Scream my name like a prayer in the wind
Watch as the darkness starts to begin
No more hunter no more chasing the night
Everything shifts in the cold pale light
[chorus]
Neon fangs flashing in the dark tonight
Spells on my lips like a burning light
Heartbeat pounding like a drum of war
Breaking down every single locked door
I rise I burn I take back the crown
I am the queen when the sun goes down
[bridge]
Louder louder let the ghosts all know
I'm the only path that you need to follow
Bump in the night now I'm here to stay
Watch the whole kingdom bow in my way
[outro]
